mostWorthwhile.text: Heating the icy body and reacting its water with silicates was the most worthwhile passage: it explained how water can be carried within rock rather than as visible ice.

leastWorthwhile.text: The separate cooling and collision steps for the rocky exterior felt somewhat repetitive after the collision that exposed core fragments.

surprise.text: A frozen-looking body can conceal liquid water and water–rock reactions beneath its surface.

arbitrary.text: Using open space to cool the altered rock was not clearly motivated before the result, although it was the only available combination.

continue.text: I would continue: the connections between asteroid interiors, meteorites and water delivery made me curious about how these materials build a world.
